points.text: This moisturizing cosmetic is applied in a thin layer over the face after cleansing in the morning and evening.
The product comes in a single size of 50 mL.
Based on finished product weight, it contains 0.10% ceramide NP, 0.05% ceramide AP, and 0.02% ceramide EOP, making a combined total of 0.17% ceramides.
It contains 2% panthenol based on finished product weight.

In a 2-week test by external testing institution Baekrok Metrology Testing Institute on 32 adults aged 20–59 with dry skin applying the cream twice daily to designated cheek areas with no other moisturizers or control group, average skin hydration index increased by 31% relatively compared to baseline when measured 12 hours after final application.
The launch price was S$28.00 from October 1 to October 10, 2026, and the regular price is S$34.00 starting October 11, 2026.
Singapore purchases include applicable taxes and free shipping of S$0.00.
